# submit

Start a turn when the session is idle.

text is required, non-blank, and at most 2 MiB of UTF-8. attachments is optional.

```json
{
  "id": "4",
  "method": "submit",
  "params": {
    "text": "Summarize this folder. Do not edit files."
  }
}
```

Started includes a new turn id. Rejected is a result, not a transport error, and does not queue the text.

A busy session is rejected with reason code busy.

The shared error object has code, message, and delivery. delivery is not_sent or unknown. A rejected turn disposition is a result, described on the turns page.

## Python

```python
from koma_sdk import Disposition

result = await session.submit("Summarize this folder. Do not edit files.")
if result.disposition is Disposition.STARTED:
    print(result.turn_id)
else:
    print(result.reason)
```

## TypeScript

```ts
const result = await session.submit({
  text: "Summarize this folder. Do not edit files.",
});
if (result.disposition === "started") console.log(result.turn_id);
else console.log(result.reason);
```
